comparison: T3 nominal parameters: serial batch_size=1, batch_timeout_ms=0, same queue capacity and length distributions; offered rate is requests / measured round wall time. T3 uses Poisson arrivals, HTTP uses closed-loop waves, so compare distributions only, never per-request trajectories. T3 retains its P0 uncached analytical service proxy; it is not calibrated cached HTTP cost.

semantics.avalanche: p99 threshold OR four strictly increasing time-weighted queue means over the final half-window, slope > configured threshold and final queue >= min_queue; finite-window proxy, not proof of unbounded growth
semantics.device: 模拟 single serial server; host environment in env.lock is provenance only
semantics.measurement: 模拟 request E2E statistics in the existing Measurement schema; memory zeros mean not measured; other metrics in summary.json; no completions means save fails without fabricating samples
semantics.quantiles: NumPy linear p50/p95/p99 across completed requests, including drain; no confidence intervals
semantics.throughput: Output tokens emitted within [0, duration_ms] / duration seconds; drained throughput also saved. Prompt tokens excluded.
semantics.tokens: Per iteration: admitted prompt tokens + one decode token per active member; unchunked FIFO prefill blocks decode. Static batches keep padded launch width until all members complete.

source.approximation: 模拟: prefill slope = P0 prefill-128 p50 / 128; decode(1) = P0 fixed 32-token decode p50 / 32. Nodes use decode(B) = decode(1) * (1 + 0.35 * (B - 1)); 0.35 is an uncalibrated batching assumption, not a measured scaling coefficient.
source.hardware_device: Apple M4 Max / CPU / arm64 / one native thread
source.limits: P0 has no KV cache and includes full-context recomputation; these are analytical extrapolations, not GPU measurements or calibrated KV decode costs. No P1-T1 measurement is available on this branch. P1-T4 must calibrate the prefill slope and batching nodes.
